ANNEXURE-II
GENERAL CONDITIONS AND INSTRUCTIONS [Read Carefully]
I. The advertised position is purely temporary under the Scheme of Pedagogy & Research
in IPRs for Holistic Education and Academia (SPRIHA), funded and sponsored by the
Department for Promotion of Industry and Internal Trade (DPIIT), Ministry of
Commerce & Industry, Government of India.
II. The appointment shall be on a tenure-track basis. The initial tenure shall be up to six
(06) months from the date of joining and may be extended based on satisfactory
performance, availability of funds, and continuation of the Scheme. The Grant for fellowship
from this Scheme is admissible only in case UGC-CSIR NET grant is not claimed.
III. The appointment shall remain co-terminus with the DPIIT-SPRIHA Scheme, and shall
not confer any right to claim regular or permanent employment with Panjab University or the
sponsoring agency.
IV. Eligible candidates are required to appear directly for the Walk-in Interview on 13th
August 2026 at 11:15AM-12:30 PM only at the Office of the DPIIT-IPR Chair, 3rd Floor,
Guru Teg Bahadur Bhawan, Panjab University, Chandigarh.
V. Candidates must report at least 30 minutes before the scheduled interview time for
verification of documents (Academic credentials/ certificates/ DOB proof, Aadhaar card and
personal ID proof.
VI. Candidates must bring the duly filled application form, one recent passport-size
photograph, original certificates, and one set of self-attested photocopies of all educational
qualifications, experience certificates, fellowship certificates (JRF/ NET, if applicable),
publications, and any other relevant supporting documents.
VII. Candidates failing to produce the required original documents at the time of verification
shall not be permitted to appear in the interview.
VIII. Mere fulfillment of the prescribed eligibility criteria does not guarantee selection. The
decision of the Selection Committee shall be final and binding.
IX. No TA/ DA shall be paid for attending the Walk-in Interview.
X. The selected candidate shall be required to join within three days from the date of
issuance of the selection/offer letter, failing which the offer may be cancelled and the position
may be offered to the next suitable candidate.
XI. The University reserves the right to cancel, modify or postpone the Walk-in Interview or
the recruitment process without assigning any reason.
XII. Incomplete applications, suppression of material facts or furnishing false information
shall lead to rejection of candidature at any stage of the recruitment process.
